Vijay Kumar M Email: vijaym1166@gmail.com Contact: +917259941166 LinkedIn:linkedin.com/in/vijay-kumar-m-028a87212 Location: Bengaluru

Profile

I have 7+ years of IT experience, with 4+ years as a ServiceNow developer being the most significant. I started as a technical support engineer resolving major incident tickets, and our main CRM tool was ServiceNow, so I made an effort to learn the platform from online resources, and then I received internal transfer to the ServiceNow team, where I worked on implementation and support projects.

Expertise in platform concepts ▪ ITSM - Incident, Major incident, knowledge, problem, and change management ▪ Catalog items, Workflow, and flow designer ▪ Integration - Data Source integrations, Rest Based integrations (Outbound), Inbound action ▪ Agile development - Sprint based. ▪ Platform fundamentals - client scripts and its types, UI policy, Business rule and its types, Script include (Client callable and server callable), Notifications and its types, UI Actions (Server side, client side and both), Data policy, ACLs (Access control List) and its types,

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE :

Service Now Consultant LTI Mindtree

09/2024 – Till Date Bengaluru, India

1) Project: Service Now – Lufthansa Airlines

Roles & Responsibilities:

Created and modified Client Scripts, Business Rules, ACLs, Script Includes, and UI Actions based on business requirements.

Configured Events and Email Notifications to support automated communication and business processes.

Created Service Catalog items and designed workflows to streamline request fulfillment processes.

Worked on production bug fixes, enhancements, and continuous improvement activities.

• Configured request forms and developed automated workflows using Flow Designer.

Created and configured Order Guides and Record Producers based on business requirements.

Resolved production defects and performed troubleshooting to ensure platform stability.

Participated in ServiceNow upgrade activities and supported post-upgrade validation.

Worked with Transform Maps and data loading processes to migrate and maintain data in ServiceNow.

Developed and executed Automated Test Framework (ATF) test cases to validate ServiceNow functionality.

Performed Health Scan remediation and implemented recommended fixes to improve platform health.

Configured and supported scheduled data imports to automate data synchronization and loading processes.

Service Now Consultant Nexii Labs

09/2022 – 09/2024 Bengaluru, India

Client #1: Dell Technologies Dell was using HPSM for their IT ticketing and they wanted to switch over to service now. I have been involved from the start of the ITSM implementation and initially I was involved in incident, Major incident, Problem track and, involved in change management and knowledge management track later.

Incident and Major incident: Configured the Assignment rules, SLAs based on the priority, Activated the Major incident plugin and setup their trigger rules, Customized the Lifecyle and configured the flow.

Change management: Added custom risk assessment questionnaires', Risk conditions, configured change approval policies, Conflict management etc. Knowledge management: Added the knowledge articles to the system, created knowledge bases, Customized the workflow for approvals and defined the user criteria. Integrations:

Exposed the endpoints to be consumed by Big-Panda monitoring tool to create an incident



in out ServiceNow instance. Integrated our ServiceNow to partner ServiceNow instance – Bidirectional to exchange incidents between the system.

Inbound – Configured the custom API using the scripted REST API and exposed the POST/PATCH/GET endpoints to be continued.

Outbound – Consumed the API and tested using REST message with the connection once connection established then have setup a trigger condition from an async business rule. • POSTMAN – Before exposing/consuming the APIs used third party tool to test the payload connections.

Agile: Used Jira to log the stories

Client #2: Nissan

Clients are using service now for ITSM alongside they wanted a custom application in global scope to support their custom labor rates flow.

Here, we built a record producer, catalog items, custom table and flow to support their labor rate charges.

Got good exposure to the platform basics and involved in an end-to-end implementation.

Agile: Uses ServiceNow to log stories, Enhancements, and defects

Technical Support Engineer

10/2021 -09/2022

Nexii Labs

Bengaluru, India

Job role as a Technical Support Engineer was to work remotely via email, e-chat, Skype for business, Avaya-phone for the Dell Technologies(client) employee of any issues like services, products, technical features, specifications and repairs on current and discontinued products, parts and options based on Dell environment.

Handling issues with applications like VPN, Bit Locker, PC Backup, MacAfee, SharePoint, Internet Explorer 11, OS, MS Office, Outlook, Skype for Business, and other Dell supported applications.

Technical Support Engineer

05/2019 - 07/2021

Inknowtech Limited

Bengaluru, India

Responsible for maintaining the Backup network, hardware, software, files on a regular basis accordingly as per the company policies.

Timely analyze whether any repairs or replacements is needed for the computer hardware.

Managing group policy for the different organization units under the same enterprise environment.

Installing software and update patches using group policy management in enterprise computers

Responsible for troubleshoot Microsoft office application and issue related to OneDrive.

SKILLS:

Service Now •Agile Development • IT Service Management • Change Management • Project Management • Incident Management • Major Incident Management • Service Catalog

EDUCATION :

Bachelor of Engineering - BE, Electrical, Electronics and Communications Engineering

T John Institute of Technology, Bengaluru 2016

CERTIFICATION:

Certified System Administrator (CSA) • CIS – Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD) ServiceNow Micro Certifications:

Flow Designer • Welcome to ServiceNow • Integration Hub • Virtual Agent

LANGUAGE:

English • Kannada • Telugu
